outcome.answer: Yes. One paper studies GNNs as fast surrogates for linear SDP solutions, finding standard architectures can fail and proposing a more expressive model that can emulate first-order solver updates and warm-start a solver [1]. A second develops a Max-Cut-specific GNN proxy for SDP relaxations that predicts primal- and dual-feasible solutions and can reduce the cost of bounding in branch-and-bound [2].
